stem:
A student built a rectangular prism using cubes that each had a volume of 1 cubic inch.

• The volume of the rectangular prism was 96 cubic inches.

• The height of the rectangular prism was 6 inches.

Which model could represent the base of this rectangular prism?
visual_elements: image_A showing a base model made of 24 cubes arranged in 4 by 6 grid
image_B showing a base model made of 48 cubes arranged in 8 by 6 grid
image_C showing a base model made of 12 cubes arranged in 3 by 4 grid
image_D showing a base model made of 16 cubes arranged in 4 by 4 grid
notes: Answer choices are images rather than text; labels preserved as A, B, C, D.
